_comment: Seventeen section-landing tile descriptions that were live in the call site but absent from the English catalog, so every non-English pack rendered a hard 'Missing string: components:sectionLanding.desc.<slug>' banner (fallbackLng is false, so there is no silent English fallback). The English leaves were added first; this batch translates them for en-GB, de and fr. The descriptive halves reuse each pack's own reviewed nouns from compliance:coverageWorkflow.* -- German 'Standortzugangsprüfungen', 'Begleitbescheinigung', 'Registerzeile', 'Notfallübungen'; French 'revues d'acces aux locaux', 'attestation d'escorte', 'exercice sur table'. The honesty halves are the pack's verbatim established tail from compliance:coverageWorkflow.honesty ('Es ist nicht Met und nicht zertifiziert.' / 'Ce n'est pas Met et ce n'est pas certifie.'), so the compliance disclaimer is reuse rather than fresh wording. Note German drops the honesty clause on the neighbouring sectionLanding.desc.data_flow_mapping leaf; that is the known content-loss defect and is deliberately NOT copied here. en-GB follows its own measured spelling convention: organisation (60 uses vs 16), catalogue (80 vs 5), but artifact stays US (9 vs 1) because it is the product's term of art. Drafts need native review.
